title: zkp-android-spartan: Spartan proofs for e-ID on Android
description: Experimental Android app that generates and verifies zero-knowledge proofs on the phone with the Spartan backend for Noir over Tom-256 (eid-privacy/spartan-backend), called from Kotlin through UniFFI. It benchmarks proof generation (with and without precomputation) and verification for the e-ID circuits c0200_swiyu_jwt (age proof on a SWIYU SD-JWT with holder binding) and c0202_sicpa_backend_constant. These are the mobile numbers of the final report of the grant.
notes: Funded by Innosuisse, grant 101.292 IP-ICT "Secure and Privacy-Preserving Credentials for E-ID", a collaboration between EPFL / C4DT and SICPA SA. Research / demo code, not for production use.
